status: Current public-evidence baseline closed; operating leverage supported, current-price five-year tenfold thesis not established.
units: USD million unless otherwise stated; figures as reported in filings, not normalized.

payback.cohort: New locations going live and product upsells in the specified month.
acquisition_costs: Net hardware and professional-services costs in the go-live month.
Sales and marketing costs two months before the go-live month, matching the median contract-to-live interval.
monthly_contribution: Subscription MRR less estimated service cost.
Average payments MRR in each new location’s first three full months live, less estimated support cost.
measurement_limits: Uses period attribution and estimated early contribution; not a record of cumulative actual cash payback for every customer.
Quarterly group financial statements lack the cohort inputs required to independently reproduce this measure.

sbc.inference_limit: The 2021 exclusion is verified; silence in the 2024 definition does not establish unchanged treatment or inclusion in 2026.

management_claims.new_markets: Above core; below 20 months in each new market is a target, not disclosed achieved results by market.

later_coverage.limit: No claim that all later conference materials were covered; exact Q2 prepared-remarks original URL was not obtained.

mrr_scope.implication: Evaluate core acquisition efficiency separately from Capital lending returns, then bridge both to shareholder outcomes.

measures: Adjusted EBITDA / Recurring Gross Profit Streams

long_term_target.ratio: Adjusted EBITDA / company-defined adjusted subscription and fintech gross profit
long_term_target.scope: Existing business, excluding potential future initiatives.

financials.fcf_formula: CFO - cash capital expenditure including internal-use software.
financials.loan_adjusted_fcf_formula: Company FCF - normal loan purchases + normal loan repayments.
financials.growth_interpretation: H1 net income rose while company FCF and FCF after normal-loan net investment fell; TTM loan-adjusted FCF of 526 remains above reported net income of 486. This is not evidence that TTM cash is below earnings or that the model has failed.

credit_asset_evidence.classification: Non-delinquent loans acquired from bank partner, held for investment until maturity/payoff; no disclosed held-for-sale balance or loan-sale proceeds in the two reviewed cash-flow statements
credit_asset_evidence.future_retention_ratio_loan_sales_or_com: Not established by the two reviewed primary filings; no conclusion that all future loans must be self-funded or that every half-year consumes another 50m.

double_count_controls: GAAP earnings already deduct SBC and credit provisions; do not deduct them again from earnings.
From cash flow adding back SBC, use a consistent compensation-cost or future shares/repurchase framework; do not charge all SBC, all buybacks and the same dilution again.
Loan-adjusted FCF deducts the actual 50 net investing cash outflow, not the 46 ending carrying value or 80 gross purchases alone.
Working capital, commissions and loan-guarantee operating effects already in CFO must not be deducted again.
Net share repurchases are financing/capital allocation, not operating expense. H1 net repurchases exceeded adjusted cash generation but existing liquidity can fund them.
The new loan portfolio needs actual funding; neither a purely accounting reclassification nor an automatic recurring 50 outflow every half-year is established.

income_quality.ttm_ni_bridge: 431 operating income + 52 net interest + 15 warrant fair-value gain - 12 income tax = 486 net income.
income_quality.tax_valuation_allowance: Full allowance against US net deferred tax assets remained at 2026-06-30; some or all may be released within 12 months, timing and amount uncertain. A release is not operating profit growth.

new_market_customers.name: Le Bab
evidence: Issuer customer quotation in May 2023 describes handheld payments and faster manager closeout.
Co-founder joined the July 2026 international customer advisory board.
Undated Leat implementation account describes multi-site Toast POS integration with loyalty and coupons.
new_market_customers.supports: Cross-year relationship and specific workflow/integration adoption.
does_not_establish: Continuous paid renewal between the dated observations.
Renewal net price, ordinary-customer support cost, or supplier cohort return.
That Toast sold its own loyalty module or that the Leat integration caused a measured retention increase.
new_market_customers.evidence_bias: Issuer-selected and implementation-vendor case studies; customer-reported benefits, not a controlled ROI study.

new_market_customers.name: District 34 Boutique
evidence: Undated Toast customer case describes marketing email, pop-up inventory queries, loyalty and checkout.
Recent search-engine cached customer-site footer states Powered by Shopify; direct page retrieval was unsuccessful.
new_market_customers.supports: Specific retail-workflow self-report and possible coexistence with a separate online storefront.
does_not_establish: Live payment routing, payment share or exclusive system replacement.
Incremental net customer profit, actual subsidy, renewal pricing or supplier unit return.
new_market_customers.coexistence_interpretation: Could lower adoption friction while limiting Toast revenue capture; neither success nor failure follows from the footer alone.

competitive_alternatives.supports: Concrete alternatives exist in the target workflows.
competitive_alternatives.limits: Packages, hardware, processing rates, service and billing periods differ. No equivalent total-cost ranking or customer contract terms inferred.

industry_scale.scope_limit: Toast global locations include new markets/retail and differ in date/geography/definition. No precise penetration ratio calculated; US restaurant establishments are not a permanent global market ceiling.

limits: Dated rounded basic shares differ from precise same-day diluted or EPS-weighted shares.
Uses reported earnings, including non-operating items, low tax and the earlier identified refund; not a normalized terminal earnings forecast.
58.4% conversion is a conditional arithmetic pressure, not an endorsed achievable margin.
Management adjusted-EBITDA target uses a different denominator and profit measure.
Revenue need not grow tenfold. Multiple changes and future share changes also affect each share’s outcome.
positive_operating_path: More effective customers in international and new retail markets.
More profitable software and payment contribution per customer.
Lower service cost in mature cohorts.
Shared product, R&D and organization costs growing more slowly than contribution.
conditional_profit_scale.valuation_expansion: Possible contributor if supported by future durable growth and cash returns; not a free plug to reach a target.

crossReviewChanges: Clarified the first three full months AFTER go-live; not the three months before go-live.
Corrected a potentially over-bearish cash claim: H1 growth diverged, but TTM loan-adjusted cash remains above NI.
Separated core acquisition payback from Capital loan investment instead of treating metric scope differences as proof of invalidity.
Narrowed customer evidence to cross-year relationship, self-reported use and possible coexistence; no unsupported paid-retention or payment-share claim.
Kept GAAP profit, adjusted EBITDA, recurring gross-profit definitions and shareholder cash distinct.

new_evidence_triggers: Latest full payback cost reconciliation including SBC and shared costs.
New-market 12/24-month cohort survival, net price, payment share, installation and service cost.
Actual loan-portfolio collections, funding and retention changes.
closure.research_priority: Retain operating-leverage hypothesis; allocate active US research to other verifiable profit-expansion mechanisms until a named new disclosure changes these questions.
